findings.desc: _pc_process_alive pgrep -f "$handle" self-matches the close gate itself (HANDLE is its own argv[4]), so it always reports alive and every glm/kimi lane now burns the full 4200s ceiling
_pc_reap_worker SIGTERM/SIGKILLs the same self-matched pgrep list including its own PID, killing the close gate before it writes review-gate.md and the terminal ledger row
leadv2-ask.sh blocks until answered; calling it inline in cmd_resolve with --timeout 1800 hangs the dispatcher up to ~35min on the prepass-park path before exit 3
ROLE_SOURCE=agents_worktree_fallback fails the `== "agents"` test at claude-subsession.sh:190, so the fallback injects raw YAML frontmatter as the system prompt and loads zero skills
the ask's answer is discarded and exit 3 runs unconditionally, so the offered "retry" option is never honored
zero behavioral coverage — no test invokes _pc_process_alive/_pc_reap_worker/pc_worker_alive/claude-subsession.sh; all three Criticals pass this suite green
empty-status→dead has no run-age or meta.yaml-existence guard, so a worker that has spawned but not yet written meta.yaml is declared dead on the first poll
_pc_process_alive falls back to `pgrep -f "${handle}"`, an unscoped substring/regex match against every process's full command line on the host, not just descendants of this worker

_pc_reap_worker collects the same over-broad pgrep -f "${handle}" match set and sends SIGTERM then SIGKILL to it, risking killing unrelated processes (e.g. a concurrent `tail -f`/`grep` on the same handle's log/journal path) that merely reference the handle string

Architect-prepass-parked path now calls leadv2-ask.sh with --timeout 1800 synchronously before exit 3; leadv2-ask.sh is documented elsewhere in this repo (glm-coder.sh:1443) to BLOCK until answered — this turns a previously-immediate park+exit into a call that can stall cmd_resolve for up to 30 minutes, directly working against the D1 goal of this same PR (freeing stuck GLM-lock holders)

None of the D1/D2/D4 tests source or invoke the real functions (_pc_process_alive, _pc_reap_worker, pc_worker_alive, or the claude-subsession.sh worktree-fallback block). D1/D4 "tests" simulate the liveness decision with hand-rewritten shell (sed one-liners) instead of the shipped code, and D2 reimplements the common-dir derivation independently in the test file. A regression in the actual sourced logic would not fail this suite despite it being wired into run-core-offline.sh as the regression gate for this PR
